about.title: Careful troubleshooting, then a clear explanation.
about.p1: Jacob Wiseman is in Elkview, in the Charleston, West Virginia area, and is looking for IT Support Engineer, IT technician, desktop support, and systems and networking roles.
about.p2: He owns NorthStar IT Services LLC, an IT services business based in Elkview and working in the Charleston area. He is also a Registration Specialist at WVU Medicine’s Thomas Imaging Center, where patient registration runs in Epic.
about.p3: CompTIA A+ and Network+ were earned in October 2025 and expire in October 2028. A B.S. in Information Technology from CSU Global is expected in September 2027.
